_comment: Gallery entries, shown in this order. "photo" is a file in src/assets/photos/ (extension optional; a .jpg beats the .svg placeholder of the same name). "category" must be one of the category ids below. "featured": true puts it on the home page (first 6 shown). "alt" describes what the photo actually shows. Captions: Event type · moment — no full names, venues or exact dates without the client's OK. See docs/LAUNCH_GUIDE.md.
_illustrative: true while these are AI-generated illustrations rather than photos from real PhotoPop events: the site then labels them as illustrative instead of presenting them as past work. Set to false once real event photos replace them.
